the downloader rejects with a network error after some progress: download-failed carrying the message
the downloader reports 'Download stopped or paused' with no abort signal: classified aborted by the message alone
the caller's signal is already aborted: aborted before any download, the single caller aborts the shared flight, a done status
the signal fires on the first progress update after 0%: the download stops, aborted, nothing installed
the signal fires when verifying starts: aborted during verify, nothing installed
the signal fires when extracting starts: tar still runs, then aborted during extract, nothing installed
tar exits 2 on the DXVK archive (scripted): extract-failed 'dxvk: tar failed', the tar spawn recorded
DXVK extracts, then tar exits 2 on the Wine archive (scripted): extract-failed 'wine: tar failed'

the Wine archive holds a symlink resolving to a path inside the fake profile but outside the extraction root: extract-failed 'symlink escapes extraction root', the extraction is removed, DXVK stays installed (T-87-16)
a Wine dir exists with a marker for another sha256 (not installed): the download replaces the directory
a DXVK dir exists without x64 (not installed): the download replaces the directory
two callers in one tick share one flight: two downloads (one per artifact, not four), both callers receive the same status sequence
three callers share a flight and the third aborts at once: the third resolves 'aborted by caller', the flight continues for the other two
two callers share a flight and both abort at once: the shared download is aborted, nothing downloads
a successful install of the current pin prunes: the current and previous pins stay, an old pin, an old DXVK, a stale temp dir and a symlink to a directory outside are handled, a plain file is left
a pin that is neither current nor previous installs without pruning: the unpinned directories and the stale temp dir stay

pruneUnpinnedEngines on its own: the current pin installed and the previous pin's directories stay; unpinned directories and a temp dir go; a file and a symlink stay and the symlink's target is untouched
no steam-engines directory: nothing happens and nothing is created
the boot sweep removes every .tmp-* directory under the root and logs how many; a .tmp-* file, a symlink named .tmp-* and ordinary directories stay
no steam-engines directory: nothing happens, no log line
